comments.author: Caddy
comments.body:
I did this one because a little bored and not a ton of info on it.

Speak to seafarer, head up to Nassau. Sink Caribbean Elite Pirates, fleets of 3 FCVs, they use flame shot. Not super tough but could be a little tougher than other fleets in the carib. No real quest rewards, and doesn't seem to be a prereq for anything, but does give a 17th century 4th period title.
